risks.risk: Hydraulic leak or low oil/seal wear causing slow lift or inability to hold load.
risks.proof: Short video: lift a known weight (or max-rated pallet) to working height, release the handle, and show it holds without dropping; also show underside for any oil seepage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven to hold load / possible hydraulic issues (worst-case: needs service).

risks.risk: Worn rollers/wheels causing rough movement, vibration, or uneven fork travel.
risks.proof: Video of rolling forward/backward on a flat surface and turning; close-up photos of wheel/roller tread and axle play.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/unknown condition (worst-case: may need wheel/roller replacement).

risks.risk: Release valve or pump mechanism problems (jerky lift, poor lowering control).
risks.proof: Video: pump up 5–10 strokes, then lower smoothly while keeping forks level; show release lever operation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven to operate smoothly (worst-case: functional problems).

risks.risk: Capacity mismatch (label unclear; could be different tonnage than claimed).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the capacity plate/label and any serial/model plate on the jack.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest confidence capacity/assumed worst-case mismatch risk (worst-case: not the claimed 2.5 ton).

risks.risk: Missing or incorrect parts (e.g., damaged handle, safety components, damaged forks).
risks.proof: Full set of photos: both fork tips, underside/pump area, handle release lever, and all wheels/rollers from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as parts condition unknown (worst-case: may require parts).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the brand/model plate and capacity rating (and serial number if present).
Video test: lift to height, hold for 30–60 seconds, then lower smoothly (show no dropping and no leaks).
Photos of underside/pump area showing seals and any oil seepage.
Close-ups of all rollers/wheels showing tread condition and any wobble/play.
